summary.text: Rob Plunkett, listed by Ballotpedia as Robert Plunkett, is a Democratic member of the Vermont State Senate for the Bennington District, which he has represented since January 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he was born in Bennington, Vermont, earned a bachelor's degree from Amherst and a law degree from Brooklyn Law School.
